title: Quick and Dirty Sequencing Microbial Genome Extraction
author: Sung won Lim

steps.title: Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the microbial sample for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Spin down 1 ml of sample for 1 minute at max speed
Decant the supernatant

steps.title: Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Resuspend the sample in Edward's buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend vigorously with 100ul Edward's buffer
Transfer the viscous mixture carefully to a PCR tube

steps.title: RNA Digestion
steps.instruction: Treat the sample with RNase A to remove RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 2ul of RNase A
Mix vigorously and vortex for 10 seconds
Incubate at 37C for 15 minutes

steps.title: Protein Digestion and Deactivation
steps.instruction: Treat the sample with Proteinase K and deactivate the enzyme.

substeps.instruction: Add 2ul of Proteinase K
Mix vigorously and vortex for 10 seconds
Incubate at 55C for 1 hour
Deactivate via incubation at 95C for 10 minutes

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA using sodium acetate and isopropyl alcohol.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a 1.5ml eppendorf tube
Add 10% 3M (pH 5.4) sodium acetate
Add a 1:1 volume of 100% isopropyl alcohol
Invert the tube 10 times
Spin down at max speed for 5 minutes
Decant the supernatant carefully

steps.title: DNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1ml of 70% EtOH and resuspend the pellet
Spin down at max speed for 5 minutes
Repeat the 70% EtOH resuspension and washing step at least 2 more times

steps.title: Pellet Drying and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and resuspend in a storage buffer.

substeps.instruction: Decant completely and dry the pellet for 5 minutes (do not overdry)
Resuspend in storage buffer of choice or dH2O to the desired volume

steps.title: Final Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the extract to ensure dissolution.

substeps.instruction: Incubate in a 37C shaker for 1 hour
Incubate at 4C overnight

steps.title: Quality Control
steps.instruction: Verify the quality of the extracted DNA.

substeps.instruction: Check extraction quality using standard gel electrophoresis
Check extraction quality using a UV-Vis method such as Nanodrop
